text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both slightly down on the day, with Ethereum showing sharper weakness at -1.9% compared to Bitcoin's -1.0%, suggesting modest underperformance in altcoins. Fear & Greed sits at neutral 50 with a 7-day decline, indicating sentiment is cooling from a recent peak rather than hitting panic. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 60% and moderate 24-hour volume of $49B reflect a market consolidating without conviction in either direction.
